commands: git branch --show-current; echo "---GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}"; echo "---APP_ID=${DEVFLOW_APP_ID:-UNSET}"; echo "---RUN=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}"; echo "---ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-}"; git status --porcelain | head; echo "---worktree"; git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir --git-dir 2>/dev/null

git check-ignore .prflow/tmp/x 2>/dev/null && echo IGNORED || echo NOT_IGNORED
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body
gh issue view 1492 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1492.md
head -c 80 .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1492.md; echo; echo "---bytes:"; wc -c .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1492.md

gh issue view 1492 --json title --jq '.title' | tee .prflow/tmp/devflow-issue-1492-title.txt >/dev/null
git fetch origin "+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main" 2>&1 | tail -1
BRANCH=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/branch-for-issue.py 1492 --title-file .prflow/tmp/devflow-issue-1492-title.txt) && echo "BRANCH=$BRANCH" && git checkout -b "$BRANCH" origin/main 2>&1 | tail -2

echo "=== agent file count & bytes ==="
git ls-files 'agents/*.md' | xargs wc -c | tail -20
echo "=== the five target files ==="
for f in silent-failure-hunter comment-analyzer code-reviewer pr-test-analyzer type-design-analyzer; do wc -c "agents/$f.md"; done
echo "=== citation check (#digits / AC digits) in the five ==="
rg -n '#[0-9]+|\bAC[0-9]+' agents/silent-failure-hunter.md agents/comment-analyzer.md agents/code-reviewer.md agents/pr-test-analyzer.md agents/type-design-analyzer.md || echo  …[per-command-truncated]

echo "=== displaced-path routing paragraph identical between code-reviewer & comment-analyzer? ==="
diff <(grep -n '\*\*displaced-path routing\.\*\*' agents/code-reviewer.md | cut -d: -f1 | xargs -I{} sed -n '{}p' agents/code-reviewer.md) <(grep -n '\*\*displaced-path routing\.\*\*' agents/comment-analyzer.md | cut -d: -f1 | xargs -I{} sed -n '{}p' agents/comment-analyzer.md) && echo "IDENTICAL" || echo "DIFFERS"
echo "=== checklist-verifier untouched ==="
git status --porcelain agents/checklist …[per-command-truncated]

git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/issue-1492-chore-agents-editorially-compress-the-five" 2>&1 | tail -1
BODY=$(printf '%s\n' "Work in progress — automated review pending." "" "Resolves #1492" "[View run](https://github.com/The01Geek/prflow/actions/runs/31334012858)" "" 'Generated via `/prflow:implement 1492`')
gh pr create --base main --draft --title "chore(agents): editorially compress the five vendored pr-review-toolkit review agents under the instruction-plus-consequence prose rule" --body "$B …[per-command-truncated]

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp"
[ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ] && setopt nonomatch || :
set -- "$ROOT"/.prflow/tmp/review/*/*/iter-*.json
{ [ -e "$1" ] && printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort; } | tee "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before" >/dev/null || :
echo "snapshot written; pre-existing iters:"; cat "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before" 2>/dev/null | wc -l

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp"
find "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/review" -name 'iter-*.json' 2>/dev/null | sort | tee "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before"
echo "--- count:"; find "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/review" -name 'iter-*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l

# Resolve triggering comment id (the /prflow:implement comment that is not the workpad)
TRIGGER_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1492/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "trigger comment id: $TRIGGER_ID"
if [ -n "$TRIGGER_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then
  .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event …[per-command-truncated]

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment 5233659318 --reaction hooray --report-failure && echo "reaction applied" || echo "reaction best-effort non-zero (non-blocking)"

rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/implement-active-1492" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1492.md" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "=== terminal self-check: workpad Status ==="
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py status 1492
